links.comparator_used: Zero-shot transfer of the model to the external Chinese cohort without adaptation
links.outcome: External accuracy and QWK on the independent Chinese cohort for KL grading
links.effect: External accuracy rose from 66.1% (zero-shot) to 80.0% after selective fine-tuning; QWK reached 0.950; AUC 0.984 for KL≥2
links.quote: While external zero-shot deployment revealed a domain gap, with accuracy dropping to 66.1%, our selective fine-tuning protocol significantly bridged this divide, boosting external accuracy to 80.0% and QWK to 0.950, with an AUC of 0.984 for clinically significant osteoarthritis (KL≥2).

design_hint: local fine-tuning/recalibration before deployment at external site
